summary: Migrations from RPM to containerized, OpenShift or the managed offering are fully supported in 2.6 once you are on the latest version of your current install, and the installer handles the components introduced in 2.5 for direct 2.4 to 2.6 upgrades. EDA from the 2.4 technical preview cannot be upgraded; install a new 2.6 and re-create its configuration manually.
questions: Are migrations from RPM to containerized supported in AAP 2.6?
Can I upgrade Event-Driven Ansible from 2.4 to 2.6?
Does the installer add platform gateway when upgrading 2.4 to 2.6?
